function.description: Retrieve a list of movies based on director, genre, and cast preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

directed_by.description: Name of the director to filter the movies. Use 'dontcare' to include all directors.

genre.description: Genre of the movies to filter. Use 'dontcare' to include all genres.

function.name: Restaurants_2_ReserveRestaurant
function.description: Make a table reservation at a specified restaurant for a certain number of guests on a given date and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant_name.description: The name of the restaurant where the reservation is to be made.

location.description: The location of the restaurant in the format of 'City, State', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'New York, NY'.

time.description: The tentative time for the reservation in 24-hour format (e.g., '18:30' for 6:30 PM).

number_of_seats.description: The number of seats to reserve at the restaurant. Must be a positive integer.

date.description: The tentative date for the reservation in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today's date if not provided.

function.name: Restaurants_2_FindRestaurants
function.description: Finds restaurants within a specified location and filtered by category, price range, and vegetarian options availability. The search can also be extended to include restaurants with outdoor seating. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

category.description: The type of cuisine or food category offered by the restaurant, such as 'Italian', 'Chinese', or 'Vegetarian'.

location.description: The city where the restaurant is located, in the format of 'City, State', such as 'San Francisco, CA'.

price_range.description: The price category of the restaurant's offerings. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

has_vegetarian_options.description: Indicates whether the restaurant provides adequate vegetarian options. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.

has_seating_outdoors.description: Denotes if the restaurant has outdoor seating available. The default is 'dontcare', indicating no preference.
